name: single_leg_pair
author: BlitzkriegBot
description: Single-leg round participant for binary rounds (@almach mechanism, issue #387): 55.1% of the wallet's 15m rounds had only ONE leg worth lifting — outside pair_discount_arb's action space. When a round exposes a sole liftable leg (the other side's ask is gone) or a declared leader (strictly higher ask, gap >= min_gap), buy that side at its ask when it prices inside [min_entry_price, max_entry_price] (default 0.55-0.85 — the favourable part of the ledger's own single-leg odds table; the 0.50-0.55 coin-flip dead band and the sub-0.50 lottery zone are refused). The position is a NAKED directional leg: its stop is the strategy's own deadline exit (time_left <= stop_deadline_sec emits a 'single-leg stop' intent per entered leg, routed by the kernel as StrategySignal — priced, risk-checked, executed; no merge is ever emitted because no complete pair exists), its cap is the strategy's own per-round max_open_positions, and NOTHING is waived — every kernel gate (timing, momentum, risk, sizing) applies at full strength; the fee schedule must be in force or nothing prices (fail-closed). holds_to_settlement only tells the kernel's generic exit ladder to leave the legs alone: settlement semantics are untouched — the winner redeems $1.00, the loser zero, and a leg without REDEEM evidence is honestly held. Signal-only: the kernel adjudicates, sizes, gates and settles every intent.
